rules.details: NEVER cold water. Never on empty stomach. Always with ≥5 almonds or 30g chana. Sip slowly over 5 min, never gulp. Cold whey on recovering gastritis = guaranteed bloating.
Keep ≥200g paneer block available at all times. 5-min pan-toss = instant protein rescue on cook-fail nights.
Allowed only on well-hydrated + low-stress days. NEVER post-gym on empty/dehydrated stomach. Triggered midnight gastritis vomiting on Day 12.
Skip all protein powder for 24hrs after any vomiting incident. Restart with lukewarm water only.
Permanent sub until grip + core strength builds. Review at Phase 1 end (Week 4).
Dabur digestive herb candy — NOT a Rule 5 sugar sweet. Appropriate for post-nausea or digestive distress. Up to 8–10 pieces per incident.
Deep-fried pakodis = Rule 4 violation, even 2 pieces. Air-fryer (0.5 tsp spray, 190°C, 12 min) = identical texture, zero violation. Always tell cook to use airfryer.
Besan + buttermilk, no ENO, no frying, gut-safe. Requires 20 min cook time. Better than curd+banana for protein (~6g vs ~8g but more satisfying).

rules.details: 30g roasted chana packed every office day before leaving. Prevents the fruit-only snack pattern that caused protein gaps 3 days in a row.
Must be BRUNCH (10:30 AM+), never breakfast. Calcium in paneer blocks thyroxine if eaten within 4 hrs of 6 AM pill.
Dosa batter (rice + urad dal) = no maida, no calcium, thyroxine-safe. Fermented = gut-friendly. Replaces besan chilla as a valid morning option.

rules.rule: No non-veg on Tuesdays + Hindu festivals
rules.details: Permanent personal observance. Vegetarian only on these days regardless of cook availability.

Cold fridge water in hot weather caused fever on Day 15. Drink room temperature or warm water only. During summer, fill a bottle and leave on counter 30 min before drinking. This is PERMANENT, not just when sick.
No mango shake, no milk-based drinks at night from Apr 23–27 (Thu–Mon). Prevent W5 water retention repeat before W6 weigh-in (Apr 27). Mango OK daytime only, whole fruit, max 1/day, before 4 PM.

During W6 prep and post-antibiotic gut recovery: if eating out, choose one protein main + one controlled carb only. No mixed dessert sampling, no maida roll/naan, no biryani + kebab + dessert stacking.

For practical dinner planning while LPG is out: suggest one main + one carb only. If non-veg is chosen, do not pair chicken with curd in the same meal. Since user also flags chicken+lauki as incompatible for his protocol, avoid that pairing in recommendations too.
